credits.title: What They Left Us
credits.overview: Four friends, Bara, Rafa, David and Momon celebrated their school farewell together. However, what if that togetherness turns out to be the last time?

credits.title: Dominion of Darkness: Rephaim
credits.overview: Following a catastrophic, failed ritual in a remote Indonesian province, two Catholic exorcists are deployed to confront a devastatingly powerful ancient entity unleashed by an ancestral pact for illicit wealth.

credits.title: Sinister Doll
credits.overview: A teenager, Pelangi, chances upon a banana tree plantation that is guarded by a mysterious old man. Apart from finding out that a young girl was buried with her favorite doll in this banana plantation decades ago, Pelangi also uncovers a horrifying secret about her death.
